create_parameter: create a torch.nn.Parameter tensor that auto-registers as a module parameter with nn.Module
create_uninitialized_parameter: create an UninitializedParameter with unknown shape that materializes on forward pass
create_uninitialized_buffer: create an UninitializedBuffer with unknown shape for lazy buffer initialization
materialize_uninitialized_parameter: materialize an UninitializedParameter or UninitializedBuffer with a specified shape, device, and dtype
is_lazy_parameter: check if a parameter is an UninitializedParameter or UninitializedBuffer using is_lazy
